name: qdrant-tls-proxy
description: TLS-terminating reverse proxy for Miyo's bundled Qdrant on :6333. Listens on https://127.0.0.1:6433 with the mkcert localhost cert and forwards to plain http://127.0.0.1:6333. Lets the trevorobeyinc-research-memory MCP speak HTTPS without disturbing Miyo or the vault-zettelkasten Obsidian plugin (both stay on plain :6333).
